attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"the early frost that has already claimed another harvest","reason":"Briefing reports one crop loss, not an additional harvest."},{"span":"It seems paying members are not paying up","reason":"Adds an unreported development to the patrol dispute."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output copies the briefing's section headings ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:') into the bulletin, which breaks character. It then spends half its length restating old news as if it were current, with embellishments the briefing does not support. The prose is also more purple ('slow death') than Brask's dry understatement."}
